scope.description: Five-node in-process scenario with true extraction: entry 5 decided with the Decide reaching only node 5, node 1 cut, node 2 elected with promises from 3 and 4, then node 5's Prepare delivered only after the leader is in Accept so its Promise is handled in the Accept phase.
assumptions: Withheld messages are removed from the queue and delivered only where the prefix says.
Holding the Accepted replies from nodes 3 and 4 models slow acknowledgement.
No ticks are called, so leadership is obtained only through try_become_leader.
excluded: Snapshots, flexible quorums, batching, reconfiguration and multiple delayed promises.

basis.prefix: Decide Value(1..=4) on all five nodes; append Value(5), deliver its AcceptDecide to 2,3,5 and purge it for 4, deliver the Accepteds to node 1, deliver the Decide only to node 5; emit ready. Purge traffic touching node 1; elect node 2; extract (remove) the Prepare addressed to node 5; deliver the Prepare to 3 and 4; collect and deliver their promises so node 2 enters Accept; collect and deliver the AcceptSyncs to 3 and 4; collect and extract only their Accepted replies into a held list. Deliver the extracted Prepare to node 5, collect, extract the Promise from node 5 and deliver it alone to node 2; collect, extract the AcceptSync addressed to node 5 and deliver it alone to node 5; collect. Emit late_sync phase=after_sync with decided, decided_before, entry_status, decided_leader2, regressed, n5_leader_pid, n5_accept, n5_promise_n, n5_promise_pid, n2_accept, promise_seen, acceptsync_seen, n5_accepted_reply. Then deliver the held Accepted replies, settle among nodes 2..5, and emit after_redecide.

comparisons.description: After node 5 applies the AcceptSync from the lower-decided leader, its decided index drops and the entry at index 4 reads undecided.

prefix.before: Identical construction to the previous run: decide Value(1..=4) on all nodes; append Value(5), deliver its AcceptDecide to 2,3,5 and purge it for 4, deliver the Accepteds to node 1, deliver the Decide only to node 5; emit ready. Deliver the held Prepare to node 5, collect and record promise_seen, route the Promise to node 2, collect and record acceptsync_seen, route the AcceptSync, collect and record n5_accepted_reply, then emit late_sync phase=after_sync with decided, decided_before, entry_status, decided_leader2, regressed, n5_leader_pid, n5_accept, n5_promise_n, n5_promise_pid, n2_accept, promise_seen, acceptsync_seen, n5_accepted_reply. Then deliver the held Accepted replies, settle among nodes 2..5, and emit after_redecide.

Emit late_sync phase=after_sync with decided, decided_before, entry_status, decided_leader2, regressed, n5_leader_pid, n5_accept, n5_promise_n, n5_promise_pid, n2_accept, promise_seen, acceptsync_seen, n5_accepted_reply. Then deliver the held Accepted replies, settle among nodes 2..5, and emit after_redecide.

before.description: The leader produced an AcceptSync addressed to node 5 after the late Promise.

after.description: After node 5 applies the AcceptSync from the lower-decided leader, its decided index drops and the entry at index 4 reads undecided.

revision_reason: Adds an extract helper that removes selected messages from the pump queue instead of re-queuing them: the Prepare to node 5 is truly withheld until the leader is in Accept, only Accepted replies from nodes 3 and 4 are held, the late Promise is delivered directly to the leader, and the resulting AcceptSync to node 5 is extracted and delivered directly to node 5 before the after_sync sample.
